reviews.text: Dr. Claudia is great!

I've finally found a truly talented, compassionate, and helpful veterinarian. Dr. Di Bari impressed me most with her very reasonable approach, both in her choices and advice, without suggesting unnecessary procedures or tests. She was able to treat even an elderly, very difficult-to-examine cat with great sensitivity. I highly recommend her.

They arrived within the expected timeframe and are always available on WhatsApp. Dr. Claudia Di Bari was wonderful. She took all the time necessary and adapted to the needs of our fearful cat. I recommend Vetathome to anyone with a very fearful cat!
Dr. Di Bari was, in a tragic moment, empathetic and professional.

I can only thank them for their professionalism,
empathy, and humanity.
A special thanks to Dr. Di Bari. Despite the delicate moment of euthanasia for my 14-year-old Amstaff, she made everything so sweet, even for my other four-legged friend, 16, who witnessed the whole thing with tenderness. It's clear she doesn't do it just for work, but above all for the love she has for these beautiful creatures.
Thank you again 🙏
Empathetic and professional
I called Vet At Home for my 18-year-old cat. Dr. Di Bari was impeccable professional and had complete empathy for four-legged friends. Thank you, and see you soon!

We called this service for our injured cat, and the doctor from Bari came for a home visit just one day later: an excellent, calm, and essential visit.
I would recommend this service to anyone, thank you!

They responded immediately and based on the medical records, provided a possible diagnosis, but unfortunately, for my dog's condition, no home intervention is curative. I thought they had an ambulance service. The dog cannot be transported.

I wouldn't even give it one star if I could. Once you've seen the animals, and as I would say, without even touching them but just looking at them, they leave you abandoned. You have to write every day to get feedback without any response, but they respond whenever they want. Terrible experience.
Very good service
Dr. Di Bari was excellent with my big dog. Besides being professional and patient, she was also kind and friendly. I recommend this center!

Dr. Claudia was truly exceptional, very knowledgeable, and very clear about everything, explaining what had happened to my cat and, most importantly, how to treat him. She answered all my questions. I repeat, she was truly the best.
Excellent experience, with quick response, punctuality, and precision. The doctor was very sweet with the dog and was able to resolve the problem immediately and with appropriate care.

I wanted to express my complete satisfaction in having used the VETatHOME home veterinary euthanasia service and above all to thank the kindness, sensitivity and professionalism of Dr. Claudia Di Bari, because in such a difficult moment she was able to make everything more bearable... an empathetic and very sweet person with our Giuditta... good continuation!!!

At a time of great concern for my cat's health, I found not only professionalism, but also compassion and sincere attention. I felt listened to, reassured, and cared for with great care.

I am extremely grateful for the service I received. My cat is very difficult to manage, fearful, and often uncooperative during veterinary visits, but the doctor was truly exceptionally kind, sensitive, and professional.

The appointment was handled quickly and efficiently: I received prompt responses, and the visit was organized quickly. The doctor arrived on time and earned our trust with calm, respect, and expertise.

I highly recommend this service to anyone looking for a knowledgeable, helpful, and caring veterinarian for both pets and their owners. Thank you so much.
Great experience

I called in the early afternoon to euthanize my poor dog, unfortunately there was nothing more that could be done, they answered immediately and we set an appointment for the same day, they were very kind and accompanied my dog ​​towards eternal peace.
Quick, responsive and compassionate vet car.

Dr. Di Bari came to give my cat her booster shot.
The exam and the shot were done!
Thank you for everything.

I wrote to you on April 4, 2026, at 2:26 PM, desperate... my dog ​​couldn't get up. I described everything to you in great detail and asked you to come to the house, even do an ultrasound... you deigned to respond after an hour because I wrote to you! And what did you say? Good evening, unfortunately we don't have availability today.
We're available from Tuesday, April 7... My dog ​​died at 4:20 PM. Shame on you... I mean, shame on you!! I have screenshots and everything... don't even try to deny it... Is this a service you offer? A 13-year-old dog... recently released from CVRS... undergoing cardiac treatment, operated on for a torsion at 12... a dog cared for and loved like a son!! And from you, the utter indifference and lack of empathy. If I could, I'd give a zero!!
Puppy (cane corso) thanks you❤️
Dr. Di Bari is very professional and competent, but above all, she has a great humanity...

The service you offer is truly special, and I'm glad I was able to benefit from it because it makes a huge difference being able to do it at home instead of going to a vet's office and subjecting the dog to additional stress. I especially want to compliment the doctor who came here, who proved to be a person of rare sensitivity. I could also compliment the speed with which you responded.
I have to point out one thing, however: you shouldn't send a review request the same day, or even just hours after the incident. It could have cost you several stars. I didn't want to do that because I want people to know you offer a magnificent service. However, a review request would have been more appropriate
after a few days.

Dr. Claudia Di Bari is an excellent veterinarian, kind, and an animal lover.
Home visits, professional and competent, with clear diagnoses and comprehensive explanations.
Competent and trained veterinarians
Punctual and accurate professionals. Recommended.
Dr. Di Bari was professional and helpful, providing us with a wealth of useful information and even suggesting an alternative therapy to medication alone.

Thank you so much, Daniela, for giving us a 5-star rating. We're happy you had a positive experience with VETatHomeRome.
Best regards from the entire VETatHomeRome team.
Great professionalism, really.

We had an exceptional experience with Dr. Ilenia Maluccio, an Italian veterinarian who came to our apartment in Rome to treat our 16-year-old Jack Russell, Jay-Z, during a difficult weekend when he was suffering from severe gastroenteritis.

From the moment she arrived, Dr. Maluccio demonstrated professionalism, compassion, and genuine care. She speaks perfect English, which made communication incredibly easy and reassuring for us throughout the entire visit. This was especially valuable given the stress of the situation.

Dr. Maluccio took her time to thoroughly assess Jay-Z’s condition, performing a careful and detailed diagnostic. Her approach was both methodical and gentle, showing great patience and attentiveness to Jay-Z’s needs. Beyond her medical expertise, she is a truly kind and humane person, polite, a great listener, and deeply empathetic.

Thanks to her excellent care, we felt confident and supported during a very worrying moment. We are extremely grateful for her help and professionalism.

My wife and I strongly recommend Dr. Ilenia Maluccio to anyone considering Vet at Home services. She is an outstanding veterinarian and a wonderful person.
Competent and responsible. Always helpful advice and attentive to the needs of our four-legged friends.

We immediately found the staff very helpful and understanding. Thanks to Dr. Claudia Di Bari for guiding Tequila with empathy and professionalism. She didn't just fulfill our request, but also took the time to delve deeper into his clinical condition by contacting the colleague who had cared for Tequila throughout his 14-year happy life. This further confirmation is a great help to us.
Empathy and professionalism, thanks to Dr. Claudia from Bari who challenged my cats' mistrust and completed the vaccination mission!

I've been working in the healthcare field with people and therefore L'oro Pet
for over 40 years:
Finding such a reliable, precise, punctual, humane, and honest organization is a guarantee of service ⚓ because professionalism isn't everything and
Passion is needed, and VetAtHomeRome proves it 🙌
A special personal mention goes to the sensitive, thoughtful, and expert Dr. Ilenia Maluccio 🎼
I share an excellent and functional experience.
Dr. Stefania Guarrasi
Dr. Di Bari is knowledgeable and meticulous. She is now our trusted veterinarian in Rome.
I am satisfied with the service and availability of the veterinarians and their kindness and competence.

Having a home vet service is very convenient. My cat is elderly, and it would be very stressful to take her to the clinic. The entire booking process is done via WhatsApp, which is very convenient.
The doctor was very kind and attentive. She examined her and took a blood sample.
I think the price for the home visit is fair, but I was shocked by the price for a basic blood test (€120) and a thyroid test (€90)!
On a negative note, I'd say the post-visit checkup left a little to be desired. The vet agreed that, once the blood test results were back, she would prescribe the medications and diet. I received the results via WhatsApp and the medication prescription with the message: "Everything normal." I asked, "And the thyroid?" The answer was "Normal." I asked, "So there's no need for a urine test?" The answer was, "We'll answer tomorrow because it's already late." Indeed, the results were sent to me at 10:00 PM.
Two days later, I still hadn't received any further information. On the third day, I asked again about the urine test, the prescribed medication (what it was for), and, most importantly, whether the doctor would call me back to explain the blood test results, the prescription, and the recommended diet. The answer was that everything was already listed on the form.
I expected at least a five-minute call to discuss the test results and explain the procedures to follow.
I wrote again asking for clarification regarding the information in the blood test results indicating "hypothyroidism." I never received a response! What a shame.

In the most painful moment of saying goodbye to my beloved cat, I couldn't have hoped for a better person than Dr. Claudia Di Bari. I am deeply grateful for the humanity and serenity she has managed to convey to me.
I thank (and recommend) her with all my heart.

Reliability, professionalism, and kindness. A heartfelt thank you to Dr. Ilenia Maluccio, who so sensitively accompanied our beloved cat, explaining everything to us with great tact and giving us plenty of time to navigate this difficult time. You were prompt in responding, easily reachable on WhatsApp, and provided clear pricing. A heartfelt thank you for working with us through this transition.

We called almost desperately because our German Shepherd puppy was complaining of pain, despite our difficulties in scheduling an appointment. The doctor who examined him was extremely helpful and, despite the boy's complete disability, managed to provide a thorough and appropriate examination. Treatment was prescribed. Now we wait. Thank you so much for your availability and professionalism. Thank you so much.

I thank Dr. Di Bari for the
professionalism and great humanity
she demonstrated.
Humanity and kindness in pain

When we contacted Neve, the doctor was prompt, kind, and thorough. She prescribed a treatment and took a blood sample.

Thank you so much.
Wonderful professional and caring, Doctor Ilenia Thank you

Efficient service and very kind staff. I chose to let my Ryo spend his last moments at home, not in a clinic he's always terrified of. The vet was very compassionate and helped us navigate those final painful moments with our furry friend.

I needed euthanasia for my cat Meldon. I wanted to thank you because, despite the painful situation, you sent me a special person, Dr. Claudia Di Bari.
I want to thank her for her professionalism, but above all for her empathy toward me and her kindness and love toward Meldon.
Thank you again.
Stefania Caporalini Aiello
Competence, sensitivity, empathy, despite the rather tragic moment, I could not have had better assistance, a truly excellent service.

We needed two infusion sessions for our cat, who had gastroenteritis, resulting in a loss of appetite and early dehydration. Efficient and timely service from the excellent Dr. Valentina, and the cat is fine.
Excellent service. I would recommend it 10/10 times over!
Valentina is an excellent technician and has great empathy for my dog.
🤩Thank you …
It turned out to be the right choice to trust them.
Unfortunately, after 17 years, we had to make the decision to let Montgomery go, but the doctor's humanity, approach, and professionalism helped us make this decision. Thank you.

In a moment of profound suffering, when our four-legged friend had no chance of recovery, we contacted Vetathomeroma for an emergency intervention. They arrived within hours, with rare expertise and sensitivity. The euthanasia procedure was performed with the utmost professionalism, but above all with respect for the pain and the life we ​​were saying goodbye to. I deeply thank the doctor for guiding us through this transition with empathy and expertise. I recommend this service to anyone who wants to ensure a peaceful, respectful, and humane end for their four-legged friend.
I had an emergency and they were very helpful, the doctor was very thorough in the examination and the blood sampling! Highly recommended.
Punctual and competent... definitely a good experience for animals who are out of their comfort zone. Olivia and Godzilla thank you for the home service. Best regards.
Expertise, Diligence, Competence and...EMPATHY...Excellent!

Excellent home delivery service, which we requested because our trusted vet was on vacation on a weekend in late July. Within two hours, Dr. Di Bari arrived to see our elderly Maremma Sheepdog, who was unable to get up and walk. Overnight, he had licked a painful paw, causing a fairly obvious wound and swelling throughout the limb. The doctor was extremely kind and professional. She examined him thoroughly, suspected an insect bite, and prescribed a seven-day course of antibiotics and cortisone, along with washes and applications, which was undoubtedly very effective.
She resolved the problem and also made herself available to our trusted vet for any clarifications regarding the situation discovered during the visit.
After 10 days, the doctor contacted us via WhatsApp and also recommended two supplements for arthritis and aging, as a good maintenance measure for the future. In short, she was attentive, even after the problem for which she was called had been resolved. Just like with humans, home medical care isn't cheap, but especially with elderly, sick, or heavy pets, as in our case, in-home care is truly a blessing. The cost of the visit and any treatment is clearly communicated at the time of booking, so you can decide ahead of time, avoiding any surprises later.
We definitely recommend VetathomeRome's home care service and thank Dr. Di Bari.
🐾
Available, professional
We needed an abdominal ultrasound and an echocardiogram at home for our sick and elderly dog. The service was efficient and the doctor was excellent. You were our lifesaver, thank you.
In such a devastating moment for us😔 they accompanied our 15-year-old puppy with sweetness and professionalism. …
Friendly and helpful staff, easy and immediate booking,

The cat is old and nervous. I had warned them to come ready to treat her, but once they arrived, I saw they weren't ready, and the cat wasn't examined. The doctor above merely took a look at the wound, which she could have done by watching the video I'd sent the day before, and I paid full price. They asked me the same amount for the follow-up visit. I will look elsewhere. Dissatisfied.
I'm so happy! The doctor came right on time and was able to vaccinate my two cats with extreme care. Thank you so much, highly recommended!
I am very happy with the visit, the doctor was kind and very competent, I will definitely call her again for my cats

A professional and kind service, in a sad and difficult time: the knowledge that we were able to say goodbye to our cat in the sweetest and most peaceful way for her.

Thank you so much.
It's good to have in-home staff available to assess your dog.
Excellent, empathetic and kind doctor.
Dr. Di Bari was professional and empathetic, she gave my cat an injection and explained many useful things to me, I am satisfied with the visit.

We contacted the clinic to help us euthanize our dog. Dr. Claudia Di Bari was very professional, but above all, very kind and empathetic. She made this difficult time easier, making it a precious memory. We are very grateful.

This was the first time we've ever used a home care service, due to the need to spare our very depressed cat any stress. We were completely satisfied with Dr. Tancredi's empathetic and, above all, professional approach. She carefully reviewed and evaluated the recent blood tests we had.
The cat was examined clinically and initial treatment was administered while a diagnosis was awaited, which could only be made following an abdominal ultrasound.
She gave us hope, and our cat Pulce thanks us!
Thanks Giuseppe 🤩 …
We had a great experience with Dr. Claudia Di Bari, who was very helpful and thorough! The service is very helpful for older animals who struggle with office visits. Jimmy also thanks us!

Professional, polite, and patient. The doctor from Bari was thorough and professional. I recommend her to everyone! She solved my Shar Pei's dermatitis problem. She immediately understood the problem, unlike many others. Thank you so much!
Thank you 🤩 …
Thank you for your expertise, professionalism, and empathy...from the phone call to the professionals. Five stars are not enough! We deserve at least praise!
Professionalism and kindness thank you very much
Expertise and sensitivity. I recommend them to everyone.
I am very satisfied with my contact with the Structure but essentially for the competence, availability and friendliness of Dr. Di Carlo
Perfect service, polite respect and seriousness. Dr. Rosella Tricardi is serious, professional and present at every single step of the treatment process. Thank you. And good work.
Dr. Tancredi accompanied our Leon to the Rainbow Bridge, with empathy and professionalism, in the warmth of our home, close to his loved ones. We couldn't have made a better choice. Thank you.
Thank you for the professionalism, kindness, availability and love shown by Dr. Di Bari. Highly recommended.
Kind, professional, helpful, and fast. Dr. Claudia was very gentle with my cat, examining him with care and attention. Very satisfied.

Excellent experience, especially with the vet Angelo. He managed the arduous task of administering an injection to our cat despite his fearful and restless nature, all with great serenity.
Highly recommended.

In an extremely painful moment for us, we appreciated the punctuality of the vetathome service and the great sensitivity and humanity of the veterinarian Dr. Di Bari, whom we again thank from the bottom of our hearts.
Thank you 🤩 …
🤩Thanks Maya. …

Excellent experience. The doctor is very professional and empathetic, and was able to resolve a problem that had remained undiagnosed for years, also providing us with assistance and prescribed treatment. All this while sparing our elderly cat additional stress and strain. It's difficult to combine so many positive aspects.

The staff's high level of professionalism and prompt responses are two features that have impressed me since I first turned to the Home Veterinary clinic. My cat is currently following the treatment prescribed by the vet who examined her and is doing better.

Dr. Claudia came quickly even in the rain
She knew exactly what to do w/ my Noah (cane)
He got a kennel after arriving here in Roma from the US... I'm so grateful to her & Vetahomerome ♥️
Excellent service. I used the appointment for my elderly cat who doesn't like being moved. The staff were knowledgeable and thorough.
